major.summary: The original plan assumed the approval/review race was safe without an explicit cross-service acceptance test.
major.resolution: The revised plan requires live PostgreSQL approval-versus-dismiss and approval-versus-snooze races with exactly one winner, consistent Recommendation/Action state, complete approved graphs and no orphan review-winner rows. It separately covers the mutually exclusive snoozed Review-now starting state.

major.summary: The original non-material UI classification did not state what semantic evidence substitutes for prohibited rendered capture.
major.resolution: The revised plan confines the patch to the existing card/native-form/flex pattern, adds semantic source-order, disabled-state, label, error and date-minimum assertions, makes no visual/responsive-quality claim and requires reclassification if the implementation expands beyond that local shape.

minor.summary: UTC and minimum-date behavior was underspecified.
minor.resolution: The UI must name UTC, derive the next UTC calendar date as the native minimum and surface safe validation errors.

minor.summary: Merged and superseded card behavior was unspecified.
minor.resolution: Both remain explicit read-only terminal states with no mutation controls and focused render coverage.

minor.summary: The DTO privacy assertion lacked a strict runtime projection test.
minor.resolution: A runtime strict view schema and negative internal-field tests are now required.

do_not_change: Preserve project-context injection, qualification through the saved signal/run/template graph before mutation, server-derived transitions, the existing versioned Recommendation CAS, no new model/provider work and the separately audited atomic Action approval path.
